scope: Offline file replay with actual host monotonic processing time; no live camera or vehicle controls
source_clock: Original decimal strings retained; release offsets are correctly parsed source timestamp minus first timestamp; span <= 2 seconds
schedule: Serial FIFO at original acquisition offsets, no warm-up; verify all images and load one model plan before starting measured schedule
admission: Probe unchanged guard at actual processing start; skip already rejected images; submit full detections at actual completion; poll again after tracking to catch deadline crossings
measurement_boundary: Queue age plus re-read/decode/analysis and sample guard update through the following monotonic checkpoint; excludes final poll execution and audit JSON serialization/publication
startup: Manifest/preflight, model loading and total startup to schedule origin measured separately
gates: Execution/verification success is separate from observed deadline success; retain failed timing results without tuning the prior 0.2-second policy
